description: Get status/result for an existing job. Polling can resume pending work; it does not debit credits again. Repeat polls refer to the same job.

job_id.description: UUID job identifier previously returned by AgentSEO; it must belong to the connected API-key account. Polling may resume existing pending work without a second debit. Type: String. Required.

name: agentseo_job_status
title: AgentSEO Job Status
